Source defect (slide 8): the apostrophe in 'OpenAI’s' is U+2019, not ASCII. Quoted verbatim; normalised to ASCII only inside the explanation.

Source defect (unmapped glyphs): slide 15 and slide 18 and slide 22 each contain U+E007, and slide 17 contains U+E009 — private-use codepoints standing where ligature glyphs were not mapped by the PDF font. These are unrecoverable from the text layer, so each is reproduced verbatim in its quote and no intended word was written. The four affected concepts are marked confidence 'medium', and their explanations record the damage instead of guessing it.

Slide 12 ('Types of models') names no model types in its text layer — only the line 'Pick the right kind for the job.' No list of types was supplied; the concept records only what the text states and is marked 'medium'.

Slide 16 ('Why long chats forget') carries only the heading and the line 'The hook, answered.', so the concept records the source's own pointer back to the slide 2 hook rather than an explanation the source never gives; marked 'medium'.
No worked examples, sample prompts or sample outputs appear anywhere in the extracted text, so every examples array is empty. No figures, tables or numbers beyond the slide text were introduced.
The manifest reports two embedded images on every slide except slide 33. Image contents were not read, described or transcribed; nothing in this output reflects image content.
